subject: art-history

source.document: AP Art History Course and Exam Description — Course Framework V.1 (© 2019 College Board)
source.track: AP · one-year college-level survey · 250 required works studied across ten content areas

note: Units follow the CED's ten content areas in order, each with its own topic numbering (x.1–x.4) and exam weighting. Foundational and intermediate lessons anchor the survey content areas; the advanced and expert lessons carry the Theories-and-Interpretations strands that spiral through every unit.

program.title: Global Prehistory, 30,000–500 bce
topics: 1.1 Cultural Influences on Prehistoric Art
1.2 Materials, Processes, and Techniques in Prehistoric Art
1.3 Theories and Interpretations of Prehistoric Art
